analysis.description: This research paper introduces a novel, text-guided method for generating textured 2D meshes that tile the plane without gaps or overlaps, similar to the work of M.C. Escher. It leverages a differentiable framework built on top of orbifold Tutte embeddings, combined with a pre-trained image diffusion model, to create visually appealing and structurally valid non-square tiles that correspond to any given symmetry group.
